items.title: 3 U.S. Utility Stocks Built For Higher Rates And Inflation Pass Through
items.summary: Higher rates, sticky inflation and a Fed that sounds in no rush to ease have pushed investors to rethink what really holds up when money stays expensive. Stories about oil, AI-related cost spikes and pressured profit margins now sit alongside worries about weaker consumer demand. This article looks at how that mix affects U.S. Inflation-Linked and Regulated Infrastructure stocks and highlights 3 companies that could be positioned on the right side of these shifts. items.title: What Does American Water Works Company (AWK) Gain From Its Digital Push And Training Hub?
items.summary: American Water Works Company (NYSE:AWK) partnered with VertexOne to roll out the VXconnect digital customer experience platform for its utility customers. VXconnect is intended to modernize billing, service requests and account management through a unified, cloud-based customer interface. The utility also opened a new training center in Indiana that will focus on skills development for field and operations staff.
